charts.title: HD 183579 b: orbits around HD 183579
charts.description: The orbits of HD 183579's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 183579 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gan et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.507.2220G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GAN_ET_AL__2021): P 17.471275 d

charts.title: HD 183579 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 183579 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (67, 94, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 320004517, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
